items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: He played just like oil hives in oil good days.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. He has a band of his own sometimes. He played just like oil hives in oil good days. Really? The sound is like oil. That was my jazz piano player, oil hives. When I say oil hives, I'm caught in a whole lot of territory. So...
Lee, we don't want to bother you with any more questions. I think that covers your life pretty well there.
